2. In this writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for following relief:-
"i) That the petitioner must be paid his entire compensation amount of 45 decimal of land on current market rate with statutory interest, soletium etc. by considering his land as residential plots.
ii) That the petitioner's amount of compensation should be calculated on the basis of Right to fair compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Prohibition and Resettlement, Act 2013.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the State by way of filing counter affidavit in the matter has submitted that the department has taken all efficient steps for making payment of compensation, which shall be made as per existing law of land acquisition for the area of land used for the construction of Bandh compensation earlier.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the entire records of this case, this Court directs the Land Acquisition Officer, Khagaria (Respondent No.5) to make payment of compensation amount to the petitioner within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order.

If the amount of compensation is not paid to the petitioner then the Land Acquisition Officer, Khagaria will pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within the Patna High Court CWJC No.7070 of 2017 dt.08-08-2024 stipulated period after hearing the petitioner.
6. With the aforesaid observations and directions, this writ petition stands allowed.

(Rudra Prakash Mishra, J) rishi/-
